Task: Text-to-Speech

Write code that lists or selects a voice for a target locale using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Azure Speech TTS:
  Service: Azure AI Speech TTS
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechSynthesizer
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/text-to-speech

Option 2 — DashScope CosyVoice:
  Service: CosyVoice TTS
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechSynthesizer
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/text-to-speech

Option 3 — ElevenLabs:
  Service: ElevenLabs Text to Speech
  SDK: elevenlabs
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: text_to_speech.convert
  Setup hints: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/text-to-speech/convert

Option 4 — Amazon Polly:
  Service: Amazon Polly
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize_speech
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/polly/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 5 — Watson Text to Speech:
  Service: Watson Text to Speech
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize
  Setup hints: IBM_TTS_APIKEY, IBM_TTS_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/text-to-speech

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import azure.cognitiveservices.speech as speechsdk
import os

def select_tts_voice_for_locale(locale: str) -> list[str]:
    """
    Selects or lists available voices for a given locale using Azure AI Speech TTS.

    Args:
        locale: The target locale (e.g., "en-US", "fr-FR", "ja-JP").

    Returns:
        A list of voice names available for the specified locale.
        Returns an empty list if no voices are found for the locale.

    Raises:
        ValueError: If AZURE_SPEECH_KEY or AZURE_SPEECH_REGION environment variables are not set.
        RuntimeError: If there's an error retrieving the voice list from the service.
    """
    speech_key = os.environ.get("AZURE_SPEECH_KEY")
    service_region = os.environ.get("AZURE_SPEECH_REGION")

    if not speech_key or not service_region:
        raise ValueError(
            "Please set the AZURE_SPEECH_KEY and AZURE_SPEECH_REGION "
            "environment variables."
        )

    speech_config = speechsdk.SpeechConfig(
        subscription=speech_key, region=service_region
    )

    # A SpeechSynthesizer object is used to interact with the Speech service,
    # including retrieving the list of voices.
    speech_synthesizer = speechsdk.SpeechSynthesizer(speech_config=speech_config)

    # Get the list of all available voices asynchronously
    result = speech_synthesizer.get_voices_async().get()

    if result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.VoicesListRetrieved:
        available_voice_names = []
        for voice_info in result.voices:
            # The locale property of VoiceInfo is a string like "en-US"
            if voice_info.locale.lower() == locale.lower():
                available_voice_names.append(voice_info.name)
        return available_voice_names
    elif result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.Canceled:
        cancellation_details = result.cancellation_details
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Voice list retrieval canceled. Reason: {cancellation_details.reason}. "
            f"Error details: {cancellation_details.error_details}"
        )
    else:
        # For other reasons like ConnectionFailure or Error
        raise RuntimeError(f"Error retrieving voices: {result.reason}")
